claim: No file of vLLM v0.32.0's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names MC_SLICE_SIZE. It is a variable of the Mooncake transfer-engine library, which vLLM reaches only through the Mooncake connectors; this engine refuses those connectors by name (its connector registry holds NixlConnector and OffloadingConnector), so no configuration the engine accepts loads the library.
